title: Lab - Network policies
description: Lock a database down to one client.
scenario: Lock a database down to one client. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inventory
tasks.instructions: Which NetworkPolicies exist and which Pods do they select?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get netpol
kubectl describe netpol <name>

tasks.title: Task 2 - Test
tasks.instructions: From the internal Pod, can you reach mysql on 3306 and payroll on 8080?

tasks.title: Task 3 - Write
tasks.instructions: Create internal-policy: Pods with name=internal may egress only to mysql:3306 and payroll:8080 (plus DNS on 53).
tasks.solution: # policyTypes: [Egress]; egress rules with podSelector + ports; allow UDP/TCP 53
tasks.verification: kubectl exec internal -- nc -zv payroll 8080  # ok; external blocked
